name: OpenTofu
description: Open source infrastructure as code tool, forked from Terraform.
summary: No LLM-generated or LLM-assisted code, docs or other PR content, because models may reproduce BSL-licensed Terraform code. Bugs found with an LLM may be reported as issues if the LLM use is announced and no fix code is included.

evidence.quote: It is imperative that you do not open pull requests containing code, documentation or other content generated or assisted by an LLM such as ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Claude or similar tooling.
Since the OpenTofu/Terraform codebase is very specific and LLMs don't have any other training sources, they may emit copyrighted code. Please avoid using LLM-based coding assistants.
If you or a human you are assisting has identified a problem with the help of an LLM then you must open an issue to discuss and you MUST NOT open a pull request.
When submitting a bug, be sure to use the template provided in this repository and announce that an LLM was used to identify this problem.
It is imperative that you do not open pull requests containing code, documentation or other content generated or assisted by an LLM
